scripts.predev: npm run build -w @idea2screenplay/agent && npm run build:compiled -w @idea2screenplay/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n agent,api,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run watch -w @idea2screenplay/agent" "npm run dev:compiled -w @idea2screenplay/api" "npm run dev -w @idea2screenplay/web"
scripts.predev:api: npm run build -w @idea2screenplay/agent && npm run build:compiled -w @idea2screenplay/api
scripts.dev:api: concurrently -k -n agent,api -c magenta,yellow "npm run watch -w @idea2screenplay/agent" "npm run dev:compiled -w @idea2screenplay/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @idea2screenplay/agent && npm run build:compiled -w @idea2screenplay/api && npm run build -w @idea2screenplay/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @idea2screenplay/agent && npm run test -w @idea2screenplay/agent && npm run test:compiled -w @idea2screenplay/api && npm run test -w @idea2screenplay/web
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @idea2screenplay/agent && npm run lint -w @idea2screenplay/agent && npm run lint:compiled -w @idea2screenplay/api && npm run lint -w @idea2screenplay/web
